summary: ENCORE Phase 2 — Candidate Loop fully validated. 18/18 new backend pytest tests pass + 1/1 health check (transcription_configured=true). Frontend Playwright run covered: manager invite-panel (enabled on approved, opacity-60 on draft), invite submission + assignment card, copy-to-clipboard producing the /take/{token} URL, public /take/{token} welcome → honor-code gating → section stage with timer/saved-indicator/scenario → textarea autosave → record-start button rendering & clickable without crash → next-section → submit → take-done → reopen-after-submit shows done → garbage-token shows friendly 'Invalid invitation link'.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_take.py correctly token-gates ALL public endpoints with no JWT (read-only-by-token) and strips rubric via CandidateCaseView — verified by test.
Storage path schema enforced: 'encore/audio/{assignment_id}/{section_id}/{q}-{uuid}.{ext}' — asserted in test_audio_upload_succeeds_and_storage_path_prefix.
Audio upload uses BackgroundTasks for transcription; storage upload failures raise 502 (good); transcription failures swallowed by transcribe_bytes (good — never blocks submit).
Assignment.token uses uuid4().hex → 32 hex chars; db.assignments has unique index on 'token' (legacy invite_token_1 already dropped per iteration-2 note).
Pydantic AssignmentCreate enforces time_limit_minutes range 15..480 (default 180) — 422 returned on out-of-range (test confirms).
Cross-manager isolation enforced on /assignments, /assignments/case/{id}, /responses/by-assignment, /responses/by-assignment/{id}/audio/{s}/{q} — all return 404 — verified.
Submit is idempotent: second submit returns 409 'Already submitted'; post-submit progress/audio also return 409.

TakeCase.jsx: Begin button properly disabled until honor checkbox is checked; saved-indicator updates as 'Saved 0:00 ago' after autosave POST /progress (verified). Console warning: framer-motion stroke-dashoffset animates from 'undefined' to a number on the progress ring on first render — cosmetic, not a bug.
InvitePanel.jsx: copy-button writes navigator.clipboard with full /take/{token} URL; clipboard read verified in headless Chromium after granting permissions.
Garbage token route correctly renders 'Invalid invitation link' text — no React crash on 404 from /api/take/{bad}.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed approved + draft cases per session via pymongo (avoids motor closed-loop issue across multiple fixture invocations). Test data uses TEST_-prefixed titles + TEST_-prefixed candidate emails. Manager B account created via /api/auth/signup for isolation checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 contract is solid. New testids verified in UI: invite-panel, invite-form (gains opacity-60 when case not approved), invite-name-input/invite-email-input/invite-time-input/invite-submit-button, assignment-{id} cards, assignment-copy-{id}, take-welcome, honor-code-card, honor-checkbox, take-begin-button, take-header, take-timer, take-saved-indicator, take-scenario (section 1 only), take-section-{id}, question-{sid}-{q}, answer-input-{sid}-{q}, record-start-{sid}-{q}, record-stop-{sid}-{q}, upload-progress-{sid}-{q}, audio-saved-{sid}-{q}, take-prev-section, take-next-section, take-submit-button, take-done. Auth token still stored at localStorage['encore.token']. Phase 2 backend tests use pymongo (sync) for seeding because motor caches an event loop reference — do NOT switch back to asyncio.new_event_loop() across multiple session-scoped seed calls. Frontend route /take/:token is OUTSIDE ProtectedRoute (verified). For audio testing, a 16kHz 1-sec silent WAV is enough to exercise storage upload + Whisper background job; transcript may be None for silent audio (acceptable). Whisper transcript on real audible audio takes ~5-10s.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial test run failed with 'Event loop is closed' from motor because the test fixture re-used a closed loop across two session-scoped seed calls; fixed by switching seed helpers to pymongo (sync). This was a test-only issue, not a product bug.
